statement: For a finite complete-intersection Fano problem of type (r,n,d_1,...,d_s), its generic complex count is the coefficient of x_0^n x_1^(n-1)...x_r^(n-r) in the product of the Vandermonde product over i<j of (x_i-x_j) and all linear forms a_0 x_0+...+a_r x_r with nonnegative a_i summing to d_j, for j=1,...,s.
notes:
The Vandermonde orientation and the decreasing target exponents are paired as in the source. This counts a reduced generic Fano scheme, not arbitrary special fibres.

The degree formula is Debarre–Manivel, Theorem 4.3; Yahl’s Theorem 2 and numerical table reproduce it. Yahl’s new monodromy results are separately credited to Yahl.

Olivier Debarre; Laurent Manivel, Sur la variété des espaces linéaires contenus dans une intersection complète (1998, article ID debarre_manivel_1998_fano). Earlier attribution or derivation. The current result cites the article actually inspected at the recorded source locator, which restates, tabulates, or specializes this earlier work.
scope: r>=1, d_j>=2, 2r<=n-s, expected dimension (r+1)(n-r)-sum_j binom(d_j+r,r)=0; general complete intersection over C.
